context:
Arkade 2FA Vault v3 is a proof of concept for ordinary L1 Taproot vault UTXOs, not Ark VTXOs. Operational has exactly three leaves: Routine is 3-of-3 PhoneRoutineBIP340 + tweak(VaultCosigner,H) + tweak(ArkadeCosigner,H); Admin/full sweep/policy migration is 2-of-2 ExternalOwnerWallet + RecoveryKey; emergency recovery is CSV + RecoveryKey. Savings contains only ExternalOwnerWallet+RecoveryKey and long-CSV RecoveryKey. H is the same ArkadeScriptHash for both routine tweaks. Every Routine spend must return non-dust change to the identical Operational script, so Routine endpoints cannot full-drain or replace policy.

Phone approval has distinct WebAuthn ES256 and PRF-derived PhoneDirectP256 identities. WebAuthn verifies origin/RP/UP/UV off-chain. PhoneDirectP256 signs the exact Arkade OP_SIGHASH digest committed in the packet. PhoneRoutineBIP340 is a random browser software key encrypted under the passkey PRF; it is not authenticator hardware or attestation. The passkey itself does not sign Bitcoin.

Audit two profiles separately. Regtest cmd/provider plus two private Emulator instances is a disposable harness with known public ExternalOwnerWallet/RecoveryKey fixtures. Mutinynet cmd/authorizer owns the file-backed VaultCosigner key and authoritative SQLite ledger in one internal-only process. A stateless gateway exposes an exact policy route/method allowlist. The authorizer has one narrow outbound HTTPS client to the release-pinned ArkadeCosigner but no inbound generic signer route, local Emulator, arkd/gRPC signer transport, raw publish operation, demo route, or external-wallet key.

Every request, PSBT, previous transaction, WebAuthn field, public-cosigner response, gateway response, Esplora response, and browser API response is hostile. Before key use, authorize verifies the exact Routine leaf/control block, full prevout, mandatory recursive change, packet, PhoneDirectP256, PhoneRoutineBIP340, WebAuthn semantics, caps, and allowance. SQLite stages reserved(request_psbt) -> vault_signed(request_psbt,vault_psbt) -> completed(request_psbt,vault_psbt,signed_psbt). Every stage counts; ambiguous failures are never released; an exact retry resumes without repeating a completed signer; a changed request under the same masked digest fails. The response must preserve PhoneRoutine and add exactly the pinned VaultCosigner and ArkadeCosigner signatures.

The exact v3 descriptor row is HMAC-authenticated with an HKDF-derived key from the file-only VaultCosigner scalar. v1/v2 schemas and funded outputs are never reinterpreted. The browser pins ExternalOwnerWallet, RecoveryKey, both cosigners, both tweaks, network, versions, scripts, and addresses. Exact authorize retry bytes live only in page memory. Admin uses the file-only cmd/adminpsbt handoff and requires exact ExternalOwnerWallet+RecoveryKey signatures; neither private key enters the authorizer, browser, gateway, or an HTTP route.

Release blockers include any generic inbound key-use route, optional/no-change Routine spend, role substitution, missing descriptor/MAC field, non-durable signer stage, external-owner private material, or v2 reinterpretation. Honest limits remain: Docker/SQLite is not an enclave/HSM; host/root or same-origin client compromise is outside the claim; public Arkade is an availability/privacy dependency; SQLite has no anti-rollback protection; external-wallet ceremonies/UX are incomplete; Mutinynet only; never use real BTC.

intake.question: What are the crown-jewel assets and failure impact?
intake.answer: PhoneRoutineBIP340 plaintext while unlocked, PRF output and PhoneDirectP256 scalar, the authorizer VaultCosigner scalar, authoritative staged ledger, authenticated v3 descriptor, external-wallet private keys outside this system, and Operational/Savings UTXOs. Routine compromise can lose bounded policy-compliant value; Admin compromise requires ExternalOwnerWallet+RecoveryKey; RecoveryKey alone requires CSV. Never use real BTC.

intake.question: Which actors and inputs are trusted?
intake.answer: Treat all network/client/PSBT/prevout/cosigner/publisher inputs as hostile. Mutinynet trusts the key-owning authorizer process/host and exact first-party signing client. The public Arkade endpoint is pinned for identity and required for availability, but every response is locally reconciled. ExternalOwnerWallet and RecoveryKey are independent wallets outside the Routine system.

intake.question: What is explicitly out of scope?
intake.answer: Mainnet, production custody, HSM/enclave isolation, authenticator or hardware attestation, shared multi-user hosting, external-wallet key generation/storage, friendly Admin/recovery transport, anti-rollback hardware, automatic v1/v2 migration, Ark VTXOs, and the full Arkade Wallet Vault-mode fork.

intake.question: What changed and needs concentrated review?
intake.answer: The v3 split between PhoneRoutine and ExternalOwner; exact Routine/Admin/Recovery leaves; mandatory recursive Routine change; all-field v3 schema/MAC; ExternalOwner operator pin; staged reserved/vault_signed/completed retry; exact two-cosigner response delta; browser v3 identity storage; and file-only Admin build/finalize with no private key or network surface.

intake.question: What invariants are release blocking?
intake.answer: Routine has one verified input, one native-SegWit recipient, mandatory non-dust identical-script change, exact final packet, PhoneDirectP256, WebAuthn, and exactly PhoneRoutineBIP340+VaultCosigner+ArkadeCosigner signatures. Admin requires exactly ExternalOwnerWallet+RecoveryKey. Savings excludes every routine signer. All secp roles are x-only independent. v1/v2 fail closed. Only authorizer owns VaultCosigner+ledger; no external-owner private material or generic key-use route exists.

bundles.name: v3-tree-and-role-separation
bundles.focus: Verify exact Routine/Admin/Recovery leaves, mandatory recursive change, same-hash dual tweaks, 3-of-3 and 2-of-2 finalization, CSV boundaries, x-only pairwise separation, Savings exclusion, final witness weight, and v3-only template/policy identity.

bundles.name: phone-authorization-and-browser
bundles.focus: Audit WebAuthn origin/RP/challenge/UP/UV, PhoneDirectP256 derivation/signature, encrypted PhoneRoutine lifecycle, v3 pending recovery, complete descriptor pinning, mandatory-change PSBT validation, exact Phone+two-cosigner signature delta, and page-memory-only retry. Confirm no ExternalOwnerWallet private/signing path exists.

bundles.name: policy-bound-routine-authorizer
bundles.focus: Prove every Routine route rejects Admin/Recovery leaves and no-change/full-drain/replacement output. Verify WebAuthn, PhoneDirectP256 and PhoneRoutine before reservation/key use; exact VaultCosigner stage before Arkade dispatch; hostile public response reduction to one expected signature; and no generic inbound signing surface.

bundles.name: ledger-schema-and-restart
bundles.focus: Audit v3 credential columns and canonical MAC, one-shot bootstrap, exact registration, no v2 reinterpretation, SQLite synchronous=FULL, reserved/vault_signed/completed state constraints, exact retry/resume, UTC accounting, ambiguous-result retention, and rollback documentation.

bundles.name: file-only-admin-handoff
bundles.focus: Verify strict enrolled v3 descriptor reconstruction, Mutinynet Arkade release pins, full PrevoutTxField binding, no private-key/listener primitive, exact ExternalOwnerWallet+RecoveryKey signature set, local Taproot execution, role-substitution failures, and operator-explicit broadcast.

bundles.name: mutinynet-deployment-boundary
bundles.focus: Prove cmd/authorizer is Mutinynet-only; strictly parses ExternalOwner, Recovery and VaultCosigner inputs; code-pins Arkade origin/base/version; pins Esplora height 1; owns key+ledger; exposes exact routes; mounts no external-owner private material; and uses hardened two-service Compose with only the narrow outbound HTTPS cosigner client.

bundles.name: regtest-is-only-a-demo
bundles.focus: Verify cmd/provider rejects non-regtest; known ExternalOwnerWallet/RecoveryKey fixtures and policy-agnostic RemoteSigners never enter Mutinynet; Emulator ports remain private in the overlay; and demo funding/mining stays gated.
